wods.text:
On a 10-minute clock, complete:
50 burpee pull-ups
75 kettlebell swings
Max burpee pull-ups in the remaining time
The pull-up bar should be 6 inches above the fingertips with arms extended overhead. Your score is the number of burpee pull-ups completed.
♀ 35-lb kettlebell
♂ 53-lb kettlebell
Post your reps to the comments.
Rest day

21-15-9* reps for time of:
Clean and jerks
Echo bike calories
*Women complete 15-12-9 Echo bike calories.
Then, at 20 minutes:
Build to a challenging power clean and jerk
♀ 65-lb barbell
♂ 95-lb barbell

5 rounds for time of:
200-meter run
20 air squats
20 push-ups
20 lunges
Rest day
Push press 5-5-5-5-5 reps

For time:
800-meter run
42 kettlebell swings
21 kettlebell goblet squats
30 kettlebell swings
15 kettlebell goblet squats
18 kettlebell swings
9 kettlebell goblet squats
800-meter run
♀ 53-lb kettlebell
♂ 70-lb kettlebell

15-12-9 reps for load and time of:
Hang power cleans
Bar-facing burpees
Use the same weight for all three sets.
All hang power clean sets must be unbroken; if you drop the bar, start the set over.
Rest day

Andi
For time:
100 hang power snatches
100 push presses
100 sumo deadlift high pulls
100 front squats
♀ 45-lb barbell
♂ 65-lb barbell

Complete as many reps as possible in 12 minutes of:
2 wall walks
2 legless rope climbs
Add 1 wall walk every round.
Rest day

On a 20-minute clock:
From 0:00-10:00, for time:
Run 1,600 meters
10:00-20:00:
Build to a 5-rep-max bench press

Service Cup Workout 2
Complete as many reps as possible in 8 minutes of:
50-foot back rack lunges
25 pull-ups
50-foot front rack lunges
25 chest-to-bar pull-ups
50-foot overhead lunges
Max bar muscle-ups
♀ 80-lb barbell
♂ 115-lb barbell

Service Cup Workout 3
Part A
On a 15-minute clock, for time:
10 shuttle runs
15 clean and jerks
10 shuttle runs
12 clean and jerks
10 shuttle runs
9 clean and jerks
10 shuttle runs
9 clean and jerks
One shuttle run is 25 feet down and 25 feet back.
♀ 95-lb barbell
♂ 135-lb barbell
Part B
At 15 minutes, on a 3-minute clock:
Build to a 1-rep-max clean and jerk
Rest day

Service Cup Workout 1
For time:
50 wall-ball shots
50 box jump-overs
50 wall-ball shots
50 medicine-ball box step-overs
50 wall-ball shots
50 lateral burpee box jump-overs
Time cap: 25 minutes
♀ 14-lb medicine ball to a 10-foot target and a 20-inch box
♂ 20-lb medicine ball to a 10-foot target and a 24-inch box

Service Cup Workout 4
For time:
100 double-unders
50 alternating dumbbell snatches
100 double-unders
Time cap: 5 minutes
♀ 35-lb dumbbell
♂ 50-lb dumbbell
Rest day

Grace
For time:
30 clean and jerks
♀ 95-lb barbell
♂ 135-lb barbell

3 rounds for time of:
15 thrusters
15 pull-ups
400-meter run
♀ 65-lb barbell
♂ 95-lb barbell

On a 15-minute clock, complete:
100 burpees*
Max shuttle box jump-overs in the remaining time
*Every minute, starting at 0:00, complete 4 shuttle box jump-overs.
For the shuttle box jump-overs, mark two lines 10 feet apart and place the box in the middle. To complete 1 rep, start standing behind the first marked line, run to the box, jump over the box, run past the second marked line, and make a two-hand and two-foot touch behind the line before starting the next rep.
If you have a weight vest (14/20 lb), use it.
♀ 20-inch box
♂ 24-inch box
Rest day

Complete as many rounds and reps as possible in 20 minutes of:
30-foot handstand walk
250-meter row
3 L-sit muscle-ups
250-meter row
The L-sit muscle-up starts with straight legs out in front of the body at 90 degrees with the heels on the floor and arms at full extension overhead. The rep finishes when the arms are fully locked out with extension of the elbow.

7 sets for load of:
1 hang power snatch
1 overhead squat
1 hang squat snatch
Increase load each set.
Post-Workout Challenge
3 sets:
1 hang power snatch
1 overhead squat
1 hang squat snatch
Choose your own load, and make one attempt.
Hands must stay on the bar; no breaking between sets.
Rest day

Every 6 minutes for 6 rounds:
800-meter run
Your score is the total time for all six runs added together.

7 rounds for time of:
7 thrusters
7 sumo deadlift high pulls
7 handstand push-ups
♀ 65-lb barbell
♂ 95-lb barbell

Olympic Total
Snatch 1-1-1-1-1 reps
Clean and jerk 1-1-1-1-1 reps
Rest day

21-15-9 reps for time of:
Strict pull-ups
Overhead squats
♀ 95-lb barbell
♂ 135-lb barbell

For time:
250-foot sandbag bear hug carry
50-second L-sit hold

40-second L-sit hold

30-second L-sit hold
100-foot sandbag bear hug carry
20-second L-sit hold

10-second L-sit hold
♀ 100-lb sandbag
♂ 150-lb sandbag
Rest day

**APEX Training Doetinchem**
Strength — EMOM 12:00
1. 6-8 DB Z-presses
2. 3-5 Strict Ring Pull-ups met 2 sec pause bovenaan

WOD — For time (time cap 17:00)
50-40-30-20-10 reps van:
- Wall-Balls 9/6 kg
- Double-Unders
- AbMat Sit-Ups

RX: SC ×3 Single-Unders – 6/4 kg; bij <3 strict reps: variant met voetondersteuning; sterker: extra load (DB, med ball, weight vest).
Scaling: dubbele reps Single-Unders; zonder springen: 15-12-9-6-3 Echo Bike calories.
